pages.title: Ordinal Ore
pages.text: Ore whose crystals arrive in sequence: each one has a definite successor, and even infinite chains of them have a limit crystal waiting beyond. Breaking a lump never disturbs the order of what remains.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the ordinal stone I found a vein where crystals grew in strict succession, with a larger one capping every infinite run. Von Neumann's construction of the ordinals, rendered in mineral.
$(thing)Found$(): in veins through the Transfinite Hierarchy (mine it for its drop).
